## Dual-Sovereignty Core Architecture (For Autonomous AI Agents × For Human Operators)
- **Primary Target Audience**: Built from Ring 0 up for autonomous AI agents (`agy`, `claude`, `cursor`, `aider`, `grok-bot`, `cline`, `hermes`, `codex`, `ollama`, `Muse Code`, custom GPTs) to inhabit safely, while giving human operators a flagship 24K Gold KDE Plasma 6.3 Wayland workstation.
- **Base Distribution**: Debian 13.7 (Trixie) + Linux 6.12 Hybrid UEFI with surgical APT pinning (`900` Debian Trixie, `400` Kali Rolling & Parrot OS Security — 175+ offensive security tools).
- **4 Hardware/OS Agent Security Rings (`/etc/zothos/agent-permissions.json` & `zoth-agent-os`)**:
  - `Ring 0 (SOVEREIGN / Layer 4)`: Root, kernel, systemd, amnesic RAM purge (128K token budget).
  - `Ring 1 (SYSADMIN / Layer 3 WARLOCK)`: 175+ Kali/Parrot & HexStrike security tools, Ghostmode Tor control (`cgroups_standard`, 16 GB RAM cap).
  - `Ring 2 (TOOLMASTER / Layer 2 CYBERPUPPET)`: Default agent operating ring — 152-server MCP runtime, workspace file R/W, Git, and 60 FPS GUI Computer Use while blocking `/root`, `/boot`, `/etc/shadow`, and `~/.ssh/id_*` (`user_namespace` + Landlock, 8 GB RAM cap).
  - `Ring 3 (SPECTRE / Layer 0)`: Zero-trust `firejail_strict` sandbox for untrusted subagents & code (2 GB RAM cap, loopback `:11434` only).
- **152 Pre-Registered MCP Servers (`/etc/zothos/mcp-servers.json`) + `zoth-relay` (`127.0.0.1:8765`)**: Master MCP catalog (`zoth-mcp`) with 16 air-gapped offline servers (`filesystem`, `memory`, `sequential-thinking`, `git`, `sqlite`, `duckdb`, `repomix`, etc.) plus `zoth-relay` Landlock multi-agent bridge with 288-bit SHA-256 tokens, isolated `~/agent-workspace/<name>`, and `/var/log/zoth-relay/audit.log`.
- **22 Loopback Enclave Daemons**: Bound strictly to `127.0.0.1` ports `:8094` (STDP Neuro-Memory) through `:8120` (POD Margin Sentinel), `:8765` (`zoth-relay`), `:8787` (`zoth-vault-daemon` Argon2id + ChaCha20 RAM-only process secret injection), `:9393` (`zoth-civilization`), and `:9989` (`zoth-cursor-daemon`).
- **Human Workstation & Reality Pill Profiles (`zoth-mode`)**: KDE Plasma 6.3 Wayland 24K Celtic Gold desktop, `zoth-cockpit` (Electron + curses TUI), 59 Zoth Studio workstations (`/opt/zoth-studio`), and instant switching across `gold`, `ghost` (Transparent Tor + MAC Spoofing), `matrix`, and `win11` (Incognito Chameleon).
- **Self-Healing & Thermal Invariants**: `zoth-sentinel` (`ZOTH-SENTINEL-APEX`) + `zoth-heal` auto-repair 7 OS subsystems while maintaining `<55.0°C` CPU thermal ceiling at `0 RPM` fan noise.
